meta.notes: Pins the helper-only boot floor (spec 4.3's precedence chain; test_dryer_restart_survival.py:364-377). Full HA restart: entity_state is null (HA lost the AppDaemon-owned sensor.dryer_state), and there is no durable store (first boot / store lost). Only input_select.dryer_state (helper_state) still says 'Running' - a bare label with no start_time, no clock, nothing a watchdog could arm against. Per spec 4.3, a helper-only Running carries no clock and 'can only seed clock-free states', so it falls through past Running all the way to Off rather than resurrecting a clockless Running - which would otherwise violate the fuzz invariant (spec 11.2) that Running/Paused/Ending must never exist without a start_time and an armed running-watchdog.
